sources.title: USDA ARS — Lewis raspberry release paper (2001)
sources.enumerated_scope: Thirteen named cultivar/release/comparator contexts in the four-page paper text and tables; two parent codes and one bibliography-only cultivar title are excluded from this bounded scope.
sources.limitations: Original four-page release paper retrieved and visually reviewed on 2026-10-09. This section retains the thirteen release/comparator contexts in the text and tables; the page 2 pedigree is accounted in a separate section with an unresolved selection-code label. Lewis is paired with ORUS 576-47 in the original paper; a current Hutton overview also names Lewis, and identity remains unresolved. Comparison cultivars are not USDA breeder assignments. Printed publication year 2001 and acceptance dates do not establish a publication day. Trial observations, rights, current availability, growing regions and image reuse are not approved.

sources.title: Lewis red raspberry — original pedigree diagram
sources.enumerated_scope: Figure 2 on PDF page 2: thirteen unique focal/cultivar/selection contexts and three separately accounted diagram nodes.
sources.limitations: Historical pedigree context from an original USDA-hosted multi-institution paper; not a current company portfolio or approved ancestry graph. One selection label between SHRI 5856/49 and Burnetholm/Malling Jewel remains held because its printed separator is unclear. The wild taxon/material node is excluded; the repeated Willamette node is separately counted. Do not infer current rights, crop traits, growing regions, company breeder/owner assignments or image reuse.

names.portfolio_context: The paper identifies Lewis as ORUS 576-47 (Origin, page 1) and shows its ancestry in Figure 2. Whether this is the same Lewis named in the current Hutton portfolio remains unresolved.
